_register: Formal and plain: no direct address in labels, buttons, titles and short hints (nouns or infinitive: „Speichern“, „Karte auswählen“); where a full sentence needs an addressee, use the formal „Sie“ (never „du“, no exclamation marks); inclusive wording without stars, colons or inner capitals: neutral nouns where they exist (Lehrkraft, Lehrkräfte, Personal, Person), the written-out pair „Schülerinnen und Schüler“ in running sentences, and the short „Schüler“ / „Nutzer“ only in tight labels, column heads and menu entries.
_quotes: German low-high quotes „…“ (U+201E and U+201C), single ‚…‘ inside; keep → as it is; Germany/Austria/Switzerland neutral (no « »).

copy.note: plural Exemplare; one physical copy with its own barcode; never „Kopie“

record.note: plural Titel; the catalogue entry of a title (Titeldatensatz only in technical text); ein Titel hat ein oder mehrere Exemplare

patron.note: plural Nutzer; library term for students and teachers who borrow; do not mix with „Benutzer“ or „Leser“; in sentences prefer „Schülerinnen, Schüler und Lehrkräfte“

card.note: plural Ausweise; the library card (Leseausweis), not „Karte“

loan.note: the act and the area (nav „Ausleihe“); verb ausleihen; a single lent item is „entliehen“; „Books on loan“ = „Entliehene Medien“

renew.note: verb verlängern; the due date is the „Rückgabedatum“

reminder.note: plural Mahnungen; the printed slip asking for the return; „Overdue notices“ = „Mahnungen“; no fines exist, do not mention Gebühren

call number.note: plural Signaturen; the shelf mark (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS); never „Standort“

spine band.note: plural Rückenschilder; the coloured band with pictogram and call number

label.note: plural Etiketten; the adhesive label with a barcode

barcode.note: plural Barcodes; write „Barcode“ in one word, never „Strichcode“ or „Balkencode“

class.note: plural Klassen; school class such as 3 B

group.note: plural Gruppen; e.g. the teachers group „Gruppe der Lehrkräfte“

reading level.note: decided: Lesestufe, not „Leseniveau“; plural Lesestufen; the school year a book is meant for

classification.note: plural Systematiken; how non-fiction is sorted (e.g. Dewey: „Dewey-Systematik“); the verb „klassifizieren“; „To classify“ = „Noch einzuordnen“

stocktaking.note: checking the shelves against the catalogue; not „Inventar“ and not „Bestandsaufnahme“

wish list.note: plural Wunschlisten; both in the catalogue and the loan area

census.note: registering patrons with their photo; „Photo census“ = „Fotoerfassung“

class upgrade.note: moving every class up one year at the end of the school year (3 B becomes 4 B); verb „aufrücken“; not „Versetzung“, which means a single pupil passing

anonymise.note: noun „Anonymisierung“; erase the personal data of a patron for good

staff account.note: plural Personalkonten; a shared login per role; the staff itself is „das Personal“

backup.note: decided: Sicherung, not „Backup“; plural Sicherungen; „Datensicherung“ only where the clarity needs it; verb „sichern“

colour set.note: plural „Farbschemas“; a palette of the interface; also the setup step „Farben“

scanner.note: plural Barcodescanner; one word; the USB reader that types like a keyboard

wizard.note: the first-start sequence; the page title is „Ersteinrichtung“; short „Assistent“

student.note: plural Schüler; short form only in tight labels; sentences use „Schülerinnen und Schüler“; the count plural stays „Schüler“

teacher.note: plural Lehrkräfte; neutral form, always instead of „Lehrer“

school year.note: decided: genitive „des Schuljahrs“ (not „Schuljahres“); plural Schuljahre; labels like „2026/2027“

configuration.note: plural Konfigurationen; not „Einstellungen“ for the area, but „Einstellung“ for a single setting

note.note: plural Notizen; the notes area is „Notizen“

return desk / circulation desk.note: the desk where loans and returns are made; the page title is „Ausleihtheke“, the menu entry stays „Ausleihe“

section.note: decided: Abschnitt for the sections of the configuration („Konfigurationsabschnitte“); plural Abschnitte; never „Zweig“, which is reserved for the school branch

school branch.note: decided: only the school branch / stream (Schulzweig) in the school setup („Namen der Zweige“); plural Zweige; never for a section of the configuration
